metadata.title: An elementary proof of a tangent-cone identity for rank-one planar Lipschitz maps
metadata.abstract: We give an elementary proof of a tangent-cone identity which might be known to specialists in geometric measure theory. It concerns Lipschitz mappings $g$ from the closed unit ball $B\subset\mathbb{R}^2$ to $\mathbb{R}^2$. Let $x$ be an interior point of differentiability of $g$ at which $Dg(x)$ has rank one. If the upper one-dimensional Hausdorff density of $g(B)$ at $g(x)$ is at most one, then the tangent cone to $g(B)$ at $g(x)$ coincides with the image of $Dg(x)$. This property is used in the proof of rigidity for the four-gradient problem. We provide a detailed, self-contained proof based on differentiability, connectedness and elementary estimates for one-dimensional Hausdorff measure, without using advanced methods from geometric measure theory.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 秩一平面Lipschitz像的切锥恒等式
analysis.workSummary: 设g从平面闭单位球到平面Lipschitz，x为内部可微点且Dg(x)秩一。若像集在g(x)的上1维Hausdorff密度至多1，则其切锥等于Dg(x)的像直线。论文以可微性、连通性和一维测度估计给出自足证明。
analysis.breakthrough: 为four-gradient刚性论证所需切锥步骤提供初等证明。
analysis.limitations: 密度上界、内部可微点及秩一均为假设。摘要说明恒等式可能已为专业读者所知，新增价值主要在自足证明。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
